overall: The AG found the Wayland Board of Selectmen violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to approve minutes of Dec 2015–Feb 2016 meetings in a timely manner, found the violation intentional, and referred it to hearing.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged the Board failed to approve and release minutes of Dec 2015 to Feb 2016 meetings in a timely manner.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board met regularly yet delayed several months before approving certain minutes, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law, See OML 2016-62.

remedy: Recommended civil fine of $1,000 for the violation
Order of immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
Matter referred to a hearing under 940 CMR 29.07(3) because the violation was found intentional
remedy_passage: We recommend a fine of $1,000 and an order of immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
